intent: vendor-hook templates: point at v2 script paths (.includes/scripts/)
notes: **Fixed vendor-hook templates to reference v2 script paths.** All three files under `src/gator_command/templates/gator-starter/vendor-hooks/` (claude-settings.json, codex-hooks.json, gemini-settings.json) shipped `python .gator/scripts/gator-session-open.py` — the v1 layout path. On v2 repos, those scripts live at `.gator/.includes/scripts/`, so every vendor hook installed since the v2 `.includes/` migration has pointed at a nonexistent script and silently no-op'd fleet-wide.

**Why the merge logic didn't catch it**: `merge_hooks_into_settings` (charter: `scripts-installer.md`) already detects and rebuilds the existing Gator hook group when template commands differ from existing commands (see `existing_gator_cmds != template_cmds` gate). But template ships v1 paths, existing repos have v1 paths — the diff was empty. The merge logic was correct; the input data was wrong.

**Fix**: rewrote the `command` fields in all three templates from `python .gator/scripts/…` to `python .gator/.includes/scripts/…`. Confirmed no other `.gator/scripts/` references remain in `vendor-hooks/` after the sweep.

**Fleet propagation**: on every governed repo's next `gator update`, `install_vendor_hooks` → `merge_hooks_into_settings` now sees template-vs-existing drift and rewrites the Gator hook group in-place, preserving user hooks. Zero code changes needed in the update pipeline.

**Charter update**: added a TRIPWIRE to `scripts-installer.md::install_vendor_hooks` recording why the templates MUST reference v2 paths and pointing at the 2026-08-03 plan for context. This prevents a future reader from "helpfully" reverting the templates to v1 on the theory that they'd be "v1-compatible" — they wouldn't; they'd resurrect the fleet-wide silent no-op.

Part of the "update and begin-session bugs" fix set (plan: `.gator/vault/artifacts/2026-08-03-update-and-begin-session-bugs-implementation-plan.md`, step B2 of B1→B2→A1→A4→A2→B3→A3). B1 fixed the script itself; B2 fixes the templates so fleet repos get pointed at the fixed script.
